definitions.explanation: A branch of mathematics dealing with the properties and relationships of points, lines, surfaces, and shapes.

examples.japanese: {幾何|きか}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{図形|ずけい}を{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned about shapes in geometry class.

examples.japanese: {幾何|きか}{学|がく}は{古代|こだい}ギリシャで{発展|はってん}した。
この{建物|たてもの}は{幾何|きか}{学|がく}{的|てき}なデザインだ。
examples.english: This building has a geometric design.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幾何|きか}{学|がく} (geometry as a subject)
- {幾何|きか}{学|がく}{的|てき} (geometric)
- {平面|へいめん}{幾何|きか} (plane geometry)

RELATED TERMS:
- {代数|だいすう} (algebra)
- {図形|ずけい} (shape, figure)
- {三角形|さんかくけい} (triangle)
